newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian 1996 car registrations up 10.7 pct in year.
newsitem.headline: Belgian 1996 car registrations up 10.7 pct in year.

text.p: Belgian 1996 car registrations totalled 397,359 cars, a rise of 10.7 percent over the previous year, the Belgian automobile industry federation Febiac said in a statement on Friday.
For 1997 it expected total sales of 385,000 cars, which is well below the normal replacement rate of 400,000 to 420,000 cars per year.
Febiac also said that registrations for corporate vehicles such as trucks, vans and buses rose 4.3 percent to 55,382 last year.
